report:
The augmented argument establishes the requested retained-datum theory for original P16.2, relative to the exact actual-ample G0 grant. This verdict concerns manuscript113 together with appendices115, 116, 117 and119 and the supplied finite-contact construction. Manuscript113 alone leaves L open. Author113’s recorded candidate=false and its three notes remain unchanged; this audit does not rewrite that record.

G0 is used only on actual ample rational bundles on smooth projective Y. Its stated finite-energy products, compactness, envelopes, integrability, differentiation, attainment and uniqueness are granted in that domain. The new divisor, cone, descent, polar and local-operator assertions were checked separately. The unindexed task passage records this grant; indexed passages correspond to the zero-based external-premise list.

The algebraic construction covers every stipulated X and every specified actual big rational L. Chow’s lemma gives a proper refinement with a projective-space immersion; taking the reduced closure of the common dense open gives an integral projective refinement. Temkin’s exact theorem applies because a finite-type scheme over an arbitrary characteristic-zero field is excellent and is a scheme over Spec(Q). Finite type over Q is unnecessary. Its finite blowup sequence remains integral, birational and projective, and the regular final variety is smooth over the perfect field k. Normal-base section descent applies with its reduced-source and generic-fiber hypotheses satisfied. These applications use [Chow’s lemma](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0200), [Temkin v2](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0904.1592v2) and [normal-base Stein factorization](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0AY8).

Big bundles on the original carrier are obtained by pushing forward a very ample divisor avoiding the exceptional primes. Smooth local factoriality makes that pushforward Cartier, and the effective exceptional difference supplies the section-growth injection. For any specified big L, the restriction estimate on the hyperplane scheme T is valid without reducedness: a globally generated twist has a section avoiding all associated points, its powers give injections, and Serre vanishing together with the coherent Euler-polynomial bound gives O(m^(n−1)). The big growth limsup then supplies an actual effective divisor G and the retained isomorphism π*L=A+D. No section-ring finite generation is assumed.

The exceptional-set argument treats whole geometric fibers. A quasi-finite point over a normal base point forces an isomorphism nearby, so every component of a bad geometric fiber has positive dimension. Restricting the retained isomorphism makes D antiample on each such component; a nonzero restricted divisor section would contradict ample section growth. Consequently all bad fibers lie in D. Properness and the singleton fibers elsewhere give π⁻¹(P)=|D| and the actual isomorphism Y\D≅X\P. The case D=0 is covered separately and does not use the level set {σ=−1}.

The all-point analytic and metric assertions hold. Proper valuative centers exist for every analytic point and commute with morphisms and isometric extensions. Units at the center have norm one, which proves literal canonical tensor, pullback and section identities, including zero section values. The bounded-seminorm center sets form a finite compact cover without a cardinality assumption. Separated analytification is Hausdorff, and a closed point of the nonempty fiber over H(x), with its extended complete-field norm, proves analytic surjectivity. Thus p is a closed quotient map, including its restrictions over ordinary open sets. Appendix119’s continuity proof is valid: upstairs the canonical metric of any pulled-back bundle is the difference of canonical metrics on two actual ample bundles; the resulting continuous, fiber-constant norm descends through the restricted quotient. This also establishes continuity of the original canonical reference.

Original metrics are produced before targets. One decreasing finite fixed-A FS net is multiplied by the cleared divisor section and descended by the actual section isomorphism. Canonical norm compatibility gives its equality and convergence at every original analytic point. The construction therefore yields genuine original-section metrics, including their prescribed poles, rather than abstract completions.

The entire declared dominated cone is established. Upward rounding is performed inside the defining net. Embedding in one sufficiently ample actual bundle and adjoining finite reference floors gives a single fixed-bundle net. The homogeneous projection formula follows from the finite rational polytope calculation, including the −∞ coordinates through floors. The convex supporting-line argument gives the pointwise homogeneous decomposition. Divisor division is performed on actual sections using height-one orders. The divided net is correctly not asserted to decrease: normalized ample compactness supplies a convergent subnet, explicit divisorial values identify its quotient, and actual-ample determination gives the all-point identity. The envelope step preserves divisorial values using actual-ample compactness, continuous divisorial evaluation and the envelope property. Hence F:PSH(Y,A)→P_M is an order homeomorphism onto the whole stated original cone. The false general extended-valued flattening lemma and its dependent nonample chain are not used. Its supplied counterexample is valid, but does not obstruct this fixed-bundle construction.

The polar test and target condition have the required strength. For normalized a, bounded-floor integration by parts gives Cap{a≤−s}≤n/s. The energy estimate retains t^n: strict locality and equal masses compare floor sublevel masses, and the positive mixed expansion gives the t^−n measure inequality. With α=1/(n+2), the transformed sublevel capacity is O(t^(−n−2)), so the energy integral is bounded by an integrable O(t^−2) tail. The resulting genuine E1 potential is −∞ on all of D. Mixed finite-energy integrability therefore proves zero D mass before any target is chosen.

The fiber maximum q_u is attained, upper semicontinuous and decreasing under decreasing nets. It agrees with u−τ off P and supplies a defined value on P without subtracting infinities. Finite retained dual energy implies integrability of every such test, and the explicit polar test forces μ(P)=0. The Radon inverse is uniquely constructed by the positive functional on continuous functions and Riesz representation. Regularity and a continuous cutoff prove zero exceptional mass; the complement isomorphism proves uniqueness. Thus the retained dual condition is equivalent to integrability of every genuine relative E1 test, with exact mass V=A^n. Exceptional mass exclusion is a consequence of that condition, rather than an imposed support restriction.

Appendix117 closes L in its explicitly stipulated finite affine FS approximation category. Common ordinary neighborhoods and principal denominators are retained. Generator bounds give a compact Q inside the original neighborhood, and one actual ample H with global FS potential p supplies v=h0+p. The compact outer-strip argument gives eventual whole-strip tails for arbitrary independent nets; it does not invoke uniform convergence to a discontinuous endpoint. The glued functions have unchanged H cocycles and one fixed outer collar. The correct canonical-reference potential is Φ=p+Ψ/R. On the inner open the literal identity is w=RΦ+Rh0+M+1.

Finite-stage genuine positivity is reconstructed in the actual ample domain, rather than inferred from a label in G0. For the finite affine FS stages, clipped section logarithms and principal localization give exact algebraic PL extensions; PL cutoffs provide support-controlled gluing. The already-glued potential is represented by an algebraic test configuration of the same actual H. Completion over k((t)) retains the literal metric. Unit-log contacts pull back to harmonic supports on smooth curves, and harmonic comparison proves their subharmonicity. The smooth-curve criterion and the formal-model criteria then give nefness of the represented model, including every proper residual curve. These applications satisfy the nontrivial valuation and good/strict hypotheses of [Gubler–Rabinoff](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2503.05513v1) and [Gubler–Martin](https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/26466).

BE7.8 is applied only over that nontrivially valued auxiliary field. Its pure FS approximation descends by Gauss evaluation: coefficient section norms are at most one, and a compact lower bound removes the Laurent tail by an exact finite cutoff. The retained coefficients generate. Summable shifts then give decreasing fixed-H original section approximants. For real constants, uniform rational rounding at each fixed stage gives the same explicit global metric in the same H; uniform closure establishes genuine membership before applying decreasing convergence to the original real-constant net.

At finite continuous stages, the original local metric products agree with the corresponding ample products through the complement isomorphism and the analytic-unit identity. The [BE continuous-product theorem](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1805.01016v3) is used within its uniform continuous scope, and the [CLD frame identities](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1204.6277v2) within their continuous scope. For bounded discontinuous endpoints, G0 is applied to the genuine global H nets. Independent local nets have the same explicit all-point global endpoint. Different collars are compared through a third smaller common collar and finite-stage identities tested by compact continuous cutoffs. This proves local-net and collar independence. The local scaling factor is R^n; it is not a claim that the original total mass is R^nH^n.

The weighted construction retains the test-containing pairing minus the zero-test pairing. Its potential part passes by genuine weighted convergence and its fixed continuous reference part by ordinary weak convergence. Frame changes have the sign w_(ge)=w_e−log|g|. Matched finite nets preserve the products, and local-net independence covers independently chosen nets in the new frame. Maxima commute with the common collar. The joint strict-winning argument with a common bounded lower floor proves independence of generated continuous references without using locality on an arbitrary equality set. Relative floors max(u,τ−j), mixed floor restrictions and integrable weighted limits consequently give the same nonpluripolar local product. Identification with the ample endpoint measure proves that its zero extension is Radon, has mass A^n and charges P by zero. Thus the pretarget pairing is identified with the constructed original metric operator before the equation target is selected.

All original continuous directions are included. Divisorial cancellation establishes the original minorant inequality exactly, including its constraints recovered on the pole fibers. The decreasing family of all original continuous majorants of q_u+tf has ample envelopes converging to P_A(ψ+t p*f): singleton divisorial lifts give the upper inequality, and the ample obstacle principle extends it to all points. This proves equality of the two outer-energy definitions. G0 therefore gives the two-sided derivative for every f∈C0(Xan), with raw factor V. No projective quotient or selected family of directions replaces C0(Xan).

For every positive Radon μ of mass V satisfying the intrinsic dual condition, its unique inverse has finite ample dual energy. G0’s attained maximizer gives an actual ψ and hence an actual original metric F(ψ). Applying the original variational inequality with both signs of t identifies the constructed genuine operator with μ on every continuous original test. Zero-exceptional Radon uniqueness and ample uniqueness give uniqueness modulo one constant at every point. Comparison, strict-winning locality and domination transfer on the complement, while the already-proved zero exceptional mass permits their full original-carrier statements. All uses of G0 have their actual ample antecedents established.

The three-dimensional toric check is valid and does not replace the whole-domain proof. The stated subdivisions cover the old octants, match on shared faces and are unimodular. Completeness gives properness. The three wall curves are P1 and have the displayed degrees, whose sum is zero; no ample bundle can have positive degree on all three. Thus this is a genuinely nonprojective smooth integral proper carrier over every retained field. The proper-plus-ample projectivity constraint is respected.

Harmless corrections and scope clarifications: BJ4.22 is a theorem, GR5.1 a proposition, GR5.4 a corollary, and GM3.3 a lemma. The A/H switch in BE7.8’s proof is resolved by consistently using its one chosen ample model. The PL-selection step here concerns explicit functions of logarithmic coordinates, as every finite affine FS maximum is. Continuity alone would not establish factorization of an arbitrary pointwise selector; that broader reading is unnecessary for Appendix117 and no arbitrary classical-psh/current density theorem is imported. The operator comparison covers the entire associated original cone through its bounded reference floors.

The listed external premises were checked against independently retrieved primary statements and their pertinent printed proof units. This does not claim reading every complete primary work or every recursively cited background proof. In particular, the Berkovich PDF exceeded direct renderer limits; its complete printed2.6.1 and2.6.7 units were retrieved through the primary PDF’s native indexed passages. Analytic surjectivity is also proved directly here;2.6.9’s cross-referenced properness proof is unused. Standard compact-Hausdorff topology, Tychonoff, Riesz representation and elementary module/valuation facts are routine background, with their new applications checked above. Hashes, compilation, historical verdicts and finite diagnostics contribute no mathematical premise.

premises: Chow’s lemma, Stacks Tag0200: for a separated finite-type morphism X→S with S Noetherian, there is a proper surjective morphism X′→X, an immersion X′→P^N_S, and a dense open U⊂X over which X′→X is an isomorphism.
Fields are excellent, and finite-type ring extensions of excellent fields are excellent; in particular finite-type schemes over any field are Noetherian and excellent. Stacks Tag07QW.

Temkin, arXiv:0904.1592v2, Theorem1.2.1: every Noetherian quasi-excellent generically reduced scheme over Spec(Q) admits a finite blowup sequence with regular centers disjoint from the preimages of its original regular locus and with regular final scheme. No finite-type-over-Q hypothesis is required.
For a locally algebraic reduced scheme over a perfect field, the smooth locus equals the locus of regular local rings. Stacks Tag0B8X.

If f:Y→S is proper, S is normal and integral with generic point ξ, Y is reduced, every generic point of Y dominates ξ, and H0(Yξ,O)=κ(ξ), then f_*O_Y=O_S and f has geometrically connected fibers. Stacks Tag0AY8.
Every regular local ring is a unique factorization domain. Stacks Tag0AG0.
If H is an ample invertible sheaf on a quasi-compact scheme, every finite-type quasi-coherent sheaf F has F⊗H^m globally generated for all sufficiently large m. Stacks Tag01Q3.

For a proper scheme over a Noetherian ring, an ample invertible sheaf H and a coherent sheaf F, all cohomology modules H^i(F) are finite and H^i(F⊗H^m)=0 for i>0 and sufficiently large m. Stacks Tag0B5T.

On a proper scheme over a field, the Euler characteristic of a coherent sheaf twisted by powers of finitely many invertible sheaves is a numerical polynomial of total degree at most the dimension of the coherent sheaf’s support. Stacks Tag0BEM.
For an ample invertible sheaf H on a proper d-dimensional scheme over a field, h0(H^m) has leading term deg_H(X)m^d/d!, with positive leading coefficient. Stacks Tag0BJ8.

For a proper birational morphism Y→X with X Noetherian and Y reduced, its maximal isomorphism open contains every codimension-one point with DVR local ring and every normal base point having a quasi-finite point above it. Stacks Tag0BFP.
A finite-type quasi-separated scheme morphism is proper exactly when every valuation-ring diagram, with its fraction field as generic point, has a unique extension. Stacks Tag0BX5.

Every finite extension of a complete non-Archimedean valued field has a unique extending absolute value and is complete for it; the extending norm is trivial when the original norm is trivial. Conrad, Ostrowski handout, Lemma6.1 and Theorem6.4.

Berkovich analytification of finite-type schemes over a complete non-Archimedean field is functorial, commutes with complete ground-field extensions and fiber products, and respects open subschemes and closed immersions. Separated algebraic carriers have Hausdorff analytifications. Berkovich1993,2.6.1 and2.6.7.
For a projective variety over an algebraically closed field, N1(X)_R is finite-dimensional and its ample cone is a nonempty open convex cone. Boucksom–Jonsson, arXiv:1801.08229v4,§1.

For a complete normal variety over an algebraically closed field, an R-Cartier divisor B is ample exactly when B^dim(Z)·Z>0 for every positive-dimensional closed subvariety Z. Fujino–Miyamoto, arXiv:2101.00806v1, Theorem1.4.

On a reduced projective variety over a trivially valued algebraically closed field, rational algebraic PL functions form a Q-vector lattice uniformly dense in continuous functions. Flag ideals give their model functions, and every rational PL function is represented by an algebraic test configuration extending any specified actual rational line bundle. Boucksom–Jonsson v4, Theorems2.2,2.7 and2.31.

For an actual ample rational line bundle H on a projective variety over a trivially valued algebraically closed field, rational fixed-H Fubini–Study functions span the Q-vector space of rational algebraic PL functions. Boucksom–Jonsson v4, Corollary2.26.

On an n-dimensional projective scheme over a complete non-Archimedean field, including a trivially valued field, finite FS metrics have smooth semipositive regularizations. Continuous psh-regularizable metrics have symmetric multilinear positive mixed Radon products, of fundamental-cycle intersection mass, continuous under uniform metric convergence and compatible with model intersection products and complete-field pushforward. Boucksom–Eriksson v3,7.14,8.3–8.5 and8.18.

On a boundaryless non-Archimedean analytic space, logarithms of analytic units are smooth with zero d′d′′. Continuous local metric intersection products are unchanged by adding these unit logarithms to their raw weights. Chambert-Loir–Ducros, arXiv:1204.6277v2,18.1.2 and8.8.5.

For a compact Γ-strict k-analytic space X of dimension d and invertible analytic functions f1,…,fr, the image |f|(X) is a finite c-polytope of dimension at most d, where c=(Q,(|k×|Γ)^Q). On a Γ-rational domain in a bounded affine analytification, with defining functions in its original coordinate ring R and nonvanishing denominator h∈R, R[h^-1] is uniformly dense in the analytic function algebra. Ducros2012, Theorem3.2 and its algebraic-reduction proof.

On a smooth strictly analytic curve over a complete non-Archimedean field, logarithms of invertible analytic functions are harmonic, harmonic functions form a real vector space, and a harmonic function attaining a local extremum at an interior point is constant on a neighborhood. Gubler–Rabinoff, arXiv:2506.13548v1,§3.12 and Proposition3.14.

Over a complete nontrivially valued non-Archimedean field, an R-PL function on a smooth strictly analytic curve is subharmonic exactly when its residue line bundle is nef. On a good strictly analytic space, an R-PL function is semipositive exactly when, after an algebraically closed analytic field extension, every pullback along a smooth analytic curve is semipositive. Gubler–Rabinoff, arXiv:2503.05513v1, Proposition5.1 and Corollary5.4.

Over a complete nontrivially valued field, formal metrics on paracompact strictly analytic spaces are semipositive exactly when their represented formal line-bundle models are nef. For separated such spaces semipositivity at every point is equivalent to global semipositivity. Nefness of a represented formal model is equivalent to nefness after any complete analytic field extension. Gubler–Martin2019, Lemma3.3 and Propositions3.5 and3.11.

On a projective scheme over a complete nontrivially valued non-Archimedean field, a continuous metric on an actual ample rational line bundle is nef exactly when it is psh; such a metric is a uniform limit of pure FS metrics on that same actual bundle. Boucksom–Eriksson v3, Corollary7.6 and Theorem7.8.
For a nonempty finite rational fan Σ and a field k, the associated toric k-variety is proper over k exactly when Σ is complete. Rohrer, dissertation,IV1.3.11–1.3.12.
A proper scheme over a field that has an ample invertible sheaf is projective over that field. Stacks Tag0B5N.
Fujino–Sato, Example4.4, records the seven-ray three-dimensional Miyake–Oda fan with maximal cones123,125,256,456,236,367,467,137,157 and457.

For a quasi-compact universally closed scheme morphism, every diagram from the fraction field of a valuation ring has an extension from that valuation ring; separatedness makes the extension unique. Stacks Tags01KA and01KZ.
If R is a regular local ring and f∈R, then Pic(R_f)=0. Stacks Tag0AFZ.
A quasi-compact scheme morphism is universally closed exactly when it satisfies the existence part of the valuative criterion. Stacks Tag01KF.

G0: over every algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero field, an integral geometrically unibranch projective variety with an actual ample rational line bundle has the exact genuine finite-energy operator, mixed products, compactness, envelopes, integrability, comparison, domination, all-continuous-direction energy differentiation, intrinsic dual-energy target condition, attained existence and uniqueness modulo constants stated in the supplied P16.1 theorem.
